verdict.rationale: Orb's docs only say it tracks recognized and deferred revenue 'with exports for financial systems' and offers managed daily exports to a data destination. That is a thin first-party export capability, not a documented GL/ERP sync. Missing for 10: named QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite connectors, documented sync of invoices and payments to a ledger, journal-entry or recognition-entry posting to an ERP, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, invoices, payments, and recognition entries sync to my general ledger or ERP — QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite — so the close doesn't need CSV surgery

citations.quote: Track recognized and deferred revenue with exports for financial systems.
Orb supports managed, daily exports of resource types to your data destination of your choice.
